svg.title: The mechanistic calculation chain inside carculator
svg.desc: A connected five-step journey transforms a driving cycle into road load, powertrain energy, scenario-dependent energy supply, and impacts distributed over calendar years. The lower row reports an actual 2025 US medium battery-electric vehicle run: component production occurs in 2023, assembly in 2024, first use in 2025, and annual and cumulative EF 3.1 climate-change impacts are shown through end of life.

g.text: the service the car must deliver.
Mass, shape, tires and slope turn
